method:rack::engine::ParamQuantity::getS.finding: P2: the binding reimplements the method instead of calling Rack's ParamQuantity::getSmoothValue. standalone_quantity.cpp:280-284 calls the qualified, non-virtual q.Q::getValue() whenever quantityTrampoline() is true, which holds for every Python-created quantity (support/quantity.hpp:44-51). Rack's definition (src/engine/ParamQuantity.cpp, getSmoothValue) calls virtual getValue(). So for a rackpy.laboratory.ParamQuantity subclass that overrides get_value, C++ getSmoothValue reaches the override (support/quantity.hpp:58-62, dispatchValue with laboratoryOverrides) but get_smooth_value() bypasses it. Smallest fix: call q.getSmoothValue() through RACKPY_CALL_DEPRECATED, as Port.normalize does (components.cpp:340-345), after the warning and checkAccess.

method:rack::engine::Port::getPolyVoltag.finding: P2: the binding's docstring (components.cpp:294-295) says "The channel's voltage if polyphonic, else channel 0's." Rack (Port.hpp getPolyVoltage) returns channel 0 only when isMonophonic(), so a disconnected port (0 channels) returns the requested channel's voltage, not channel 0's. The cited reference doc (engine-components.md:42, "channel 0's voltage on a monophonic port") is correct. Smallest fix: change the docstring to "channel 0's voltage if monophonic, else the channel's".

method:rack::engine::PortInfo::getFullNa.finding: P2: no overflow guard. Rack's getFullName calls getName(), whose fallback computes portId + 1 (src/engine/PortInfo.cpp, getName). With name == "" and port_id = 2**31 - 1 (settable through identityField, components.cpp:402) that is signed int overflow, which is undefined behaviour. The binding (components.cpp:406) does not guard it. The ParamQuantity binding refuses the identical case with ValueError (standalone_quantity.cpp:84-87, 243-244; documented at engine-module.md:263-265). Smallest fix: in the get_name/get_full_name base lambdas, raise ValueError("port ID overflows Rack's default label") when info.name.empty() && info.portId == INT_MAX, and document it under #components-info.

method:rack::engine::PortInfo::getName().finding: P1: the only cited test, test_components_owned.py::test_info_names_and_python_overrides, never calls the native rackpy.raw.engine.PortInfo.get_name binding (components.cpp:405). It reaches getName only indirectly through get_full_name, and the subclass's get_name is the Python override. Rack's numbered default ("#N") is also untested in the citation. Separately (P2), the binding has no portId + 1 overflow guard for name == "" and port_id == 2**31 - 1, unlike ParamQuantity.get_label (standalone_quantity.cpp:84-87, 243-244). Smallest fix: cite tests/engine/module/in_rack/test_standalone_metadata.py::test_standalone_module_identity_null_and_reassignment (asserts get_name() against the native reference, including "#1"), and add the same ValueError guard as ParamQuantity.get_label.
